classes.lone-surrogates: Lone surrogate escapes in parsed JSON become U+FFFD; upstream keeps them until sanitizeSurrogates.
classes.input-limits: Numbers outside the f64 range and nesting deeper than 128 levels are rejected; JSON.parse accepts them.
classes.key-order: Session, RPC and config data are compared by value; object key order may differ where upstream order depends on assignment order.
classes.engine-error-text: V8 JSON.parse error details are masked; the surrounding template is compared verbatim.
